_source: Hand-verified from BHP Group 2021 Preliminary Final Report (ASX: 2021-08-17) via docling cache (98 tables, 82 pages). All values USD millions. Scale=millions confirmed from page 44 consolidated income statement header. CF/BS/shares verified from docling tables 43, 45, 46, 57. Fixture values are what the multipass extraction system should produce (post-scale-multiplication for monetary values, raw for share counts).

notes.revenue: Table 43 (page 44): 'Revenue 60,817' USD millions. Consolidated income statement.
notes.ebit: Table 43 (page 44): 'Profit from operations' = 25,906 USD millions. BHP uses this label for EBIT (equivalent). Tolerance widened to 2% because some LLMs may not recognise 'Profit from operations' as EBIT-equivalent.
notes.np_attributable: Table 43 (page 44): 'Attributable to BHP shareholders' = 11,304 USD millions.
notes.operating_cf: Table 46 (page 46): 'Net operating cash flows from Continuing operations' = 27,234 USD millions.
notes.investing_cf: Table 46 (page 46): 'Net investing cash flows from Continuing operations' = (7,845) USD millions.
notes.financing_cf: Table 46 (page 46): 'Net financing cash flows from Continuing operations' = (17,922) USD millions.
notes.cash_end: Table 46 (page 46): 'Cash and cash equivalents, net of overdrafts, at the end of the financial year' = 15,246 USD millions. Cross-check: Table 45 balance sheet confirms 15,246.
notes.capex: Table 46 (page 46): 'Purchases of property, plant and equipment' = (6,606) USD millions. Negative per CF outflow convention (consistent with RMS fixture). Note: BHP's 'Capital and exploration expenditure' (7,120) includes exploration (514) but the prompt extracts PP&E purchases only.
notes.net_debt: MOVED TO expected_nulls. BHP's official net_debt (4,121) uses a custom calculation: interest bearing liabilities - index-linked freight - cash - net swaps - cash mgmt instruments (Table 75/84). The balance sheet (Table 45) does not break out lease liabilities from borrowings, so the system cannot derive this figure. The extraction would either yield null or an incorrect derivation (~5,737M).
notes.shares_outstanding: Table 57 (page 52): 'Weighted average number of shares (Million) Basic = 5,057'. System outputs 5,057 as raw value because shares_outstanding is a _COUNT_METRICS field (no scale multiplication). The '(Million)' is in the row label, not the column scale. BHP actual count is ~5.057 billion but the system cannot distinguish share-specific scale from document monetary scale.
